detail.longDescription: I genuinely worry about a world in which general-purpose computing is locked down by corporations and governments. I worry about a world where people are deliberately discouraged from understanding even the basics of the computers they depend on. Where everything happens inside gated communities and walled gardens, and the manufacturer (or the operating system vendor, or, Bastet forbid, a government) decides what you may install, change, create, or even understand. Computers are wonderful things. They can be tools of creativity, curiosity, communication, education and liberation. But only if they remain free, accessible, understandable, and truly under the control of the people using them. A computer you are not allowed to control is increasingly becoming something done to you, rather than a tool that belongs to you. And frankly, that worries me. Quite a lot. 🖥️🏴‍☠️ # DigitalFreedom # FreeSoftware # OpenSource # Computing # DigitalRights # Linux # Technology
